PICKLERFRIGIL-GLISTENING_AMETHYST.descri: At the start of your turn, applies {HypothermiaPower:diff()} [gold]Hypothermia[/gold] to a random enemy.
PICKLERFRIGIL-GLISTENING_AMETHYST.flavor: Gems like these have a way of concentrating magical energies just the way you want.
PICKLERFRIGIL-GLISTENING_AMETHYST.title: Glistening Amethyst
PICKLERFRIGIL-RADIANT_BISMUTH.descriptio: At the start of your turn, applies {HypothermiaPower:diff()} [gold]Hypothermia[/gold] to a random enemy 3 times.
PICKLERFRIGIL-RADIANT_BISMUTH.flavor: Magnitudes harder to control, as if you ever wanted to in the first place.
PICKLERFRIGIL-RADIANT_BISMUTH.title: Radiant Bismuth
PICKLERFRIGIL-EVERFROZEN_SPIKE.descripti: When Icy attacks deal unblocked damage, apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Hypothermia[/gold]
PICKLERFRIGIL-EVERFROZEN_SPIKE.flavor: You could cast this unto a raging inferno, yet it never seems to melt.
PICKLERFRIGIL-EVERFROZEN_SPIKE.title: Everfrozen Spike
PICKLERFRIGIL-CRYSTALLIZED_SALT.descript: The first [gold]Gemstone[/gold] [gold]Exhausted[/gold] each combat takes effect twice.
PICKLERFRIGIL-CRYSTALLIZED_SALT.title: Crystallized Salt
